consent.title: 추적 동의
consent.body: 이 사이트는 무엇이 읽히는지 소유자가 알 수 있도록 쿠키 없이 익명으로 방문을 집계합니다. 개인 데이터는 저장하지 않습니다. 이 방문을 집계해도 될까요?

chatRoom.codedWelcome: {greeting}. I'm an AI grounded in {handle}'s curated corpus. You've come in on the <accent>{codeLabel}</accent> slice.
chatRoom.codedRedaction: Private topics outside this code's scope are redacted. {handle} reads transcripts afterward.
chatRoom.codedStarters: Ask anything. Starters below if you need a way in.
chatRoom.codedGhostHint: Ask anything. There's a suggested question waiting in the box — press Tab to take it.
chatRoom.byoaiWelcome: Hi. I'm an AI grounded in {handle}'s curated corpus. You're running on your own <accent>{provider}</accent> key — public slice only.
chatRoom.byoaiScope: Work, projects, public takes — fair game. Private topics return a “need a code” response.
chatRoom.footnote: <muted>how this works</muted> · answers come from {handle}'s curated corpus. private topics return a redaction rather than a guess.
chatRoom.footnoteByoai: your api key never leaves the browser.

restrictedDoc.lockedBody: The owner has restricted this entry. Enter an access code on the gate to view the full content.
restrictedDoc.outOfScopeTitle: Your code doesn’t reach this one
restrictedDoc.outOfScopeBody: Either it sits outside what your code covers, or there is nothing at this address — the instance won’t say which. Ask below and the AI will answer from what you can read.

visitorNamePicker.full: This code is full — it’s reached its limit of names. Ask whoever shared it with you for a fresh one.
visitorNamePicker.prompt: One last thing before the chat starts — the owner sees this on your transcript later. Pick a short name; a handle is fine.
visitorNamePicker.capacityDefault: More than one person can use this code.
visitorNamePicker.capacityNote: Keep using the same name and your chats stay grouped as you; a different name reads as a new person and starts a separate conversation. Passing the code to someone else? Have them scan it and pick their own name. Rather not give a name? Skip takes one of the code's names too, as a guest — and coming back later starts over as a new guest.
visitorNamePicker.defaultGreeting: {handle}의 AI입니다. 무엇이든 물어보세요 — {handle}의 목소리로, 실제 작업에 근거해 답합니다.
visitorNamePicker.defaultGreetingAnon: 이 AI에게 무엇이든 물어보세요 — 주인의 목소리로, 실제 작업에 근거해 답합니다.
visitorNamePicker.capacity: 이 코드는 최대 {max}명이 사용할 수 있습니다 — 이미 {count}명 참여.

wikiTreeView.head: wiki tree
wikiTreeView.gatedHint: these entries are private — enter a code

readerChat.heading: Ask this entry a question.
readerChat.lede: The AI answers in the owner’s voice, grounded in this corpus. Bring your own key and start — it never leaves your browser.
